entities.summary: Jakub Čutta is a Czech former ice hockey defenceman. He played 8 games in the National Hockey League with the Washington Capitals from 2000 to 2004. The rest of his career, which lasted from 2000 to 2018, was mainly spent in the Czech Extraliga.
